### The Vanity of Political Power
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/vanity-political-power
Passage: Ecclesiastes 4:13-16
Points:
- Worldly power and political influence are deeply alluring, but pursuing them for their own sake is ultimately meaningless.
- Even the most successful rulers eventually lose their authority in death and are forgotten by future generations.
- It is far better to possess wisdom in poverty than to hold high office while stubbornly rejecting instruction and correction.
- Recognizing that earthly power is fleeting helps Christians remain steadfast and loyal to God's unshakable, eternal kingdom.
